meta.name: cavecrew
meta.description: When to delegate to `cavecrew-investigator` (locate code), `cavecrew-builder` (1-2 file edit) or `cavecrew-reviewer` (diff review) instead of working inline or using `Explore`. Their output is compressed, so main context lasts longer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按需分派子代理处理代码定位、修改与审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常用 AI 写代码,想通过子代理分工节省上下文。
copy.tagline_en: Delegate to sub-agents for code search, edits, and reviews to save context.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code with AI and want to manage context by delegating tasks to sub-agents.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把「定位代码、改 1-2 个文件、审 diff」派给三个子代理(investigator / builder / reviewer),它们返回压缩的结构化结果而非大段文字,主上下文更省。
howto.when: 当你要定位代码位置、做 1-2 个文件的小改动,或审查 diff 时,会分别由对应的子代理接管。

say.text: 用 cavecrew-investigator 找出 foo 在哪定义、谁调用它
say.note: 返回「路径:行号 — 符号」清单

say.text: 用 cavecrew-reviewer 审一下当前 diff 有没有 bug
say.note: 按文件→行号排序列出问题

howto.what_en: Claude delegates locate-code, small 1-2 file edits, and diff review to three subagents (investigator / builder / reviewer). They return compressed structured results instead of prose, so the main context lasts longer.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to locate code, make a small 1-2 file edit, or review a diff; each case goes to its matching subagent.

say_en.text: Use cavecrew-investigator to find where foo is defined and who calls it
Change src/a.ts:42 to return null with cavecrew-builder
say_en.note: Makes that edit, then re-reads to verify

say_en.text: Use cavecrew-reviewer to check the current diff for bugs
say_en.note: Lists findings sorted file to line
